body: I tested something: Currently is possible query by ObjectID This picture is using index panel and I get the result. So basically, Need to do the same but from `` I saw that the component serialize the widgets urls. For example, if I have a `condition` refinement with `used|new` as value, the url for filter by `new` looks like: ``` https://market.windtoday.co/?refinementList[condition][0]=new ``` serialized into: ``` https%3A%2F%2Fmarket.windtoday.co%2F%3FrefinementList%5Bcondition%5D%5B0%5D%3Dnew ``` In the objectID case, I suppose that is necessary define the way to serialize the objectID value as the backend is expecting it? similar to ``` https://market.windtoday.co/?[objectID]=3566358081 ```
